name: Team Ideas Board
description: Turn team suggestions into next steps: capture ideas, search a shared board, and move promising improvements from New to Exploring to Planned. A clean SharePoint-backed app starter.
author: adilei

prerequisites: Access to Copilot Managed Runtime app creation in an eligible environment; tenant licensing and connector policies apply.
An existing SharePoint list named Team Ideas or team-ideas, with the displayed column names and types below. CSV-created internal names are resolved from the native schema.
Read, create, and edit permission on that list. No custom app registration is required for the standard connection flow.

Install on macOS with Bash or on Windows with PowerShell 5.1+. The shared installer checks Node >=24.11, npm, Git, and Git Credential Manager, and offers to install missing prerequisites with your approval. Linux installation is not supported.

connectors.instructions: Create a list named Team Ideas or team-ideas first. In the native CLI, choose your SharePoint connection, the site where you created the list (called a dataset), and the list itself. Keep the displayed column names and types below; the app resolves their native internal names during its build. This app reads up to 200 ideas and supports creating ideas and changing their status.

columns.name: Title
columns.description: Required. The built-in Title column; keep its internal name.

columns.name: Details
columns.description: Plain text; optional. Keep the display name Details.

columns.name: Status
columns.description: Required. Default: New. App values: New, Exploring, Planned.

columns.name: Priority
columns.description: Required. Default: Medium. App values: Low, Medium, High.

screenshot.alt: Illustrative Team Ideas Board with six synthetic ideas grouped by status; not a live data connection.
